result:
Fixed in `anthrouter/pace.py`. `period_workday_dates` treated `period_end` (the first day of the next month) as inclusive. In UTC that pulled Oct 1, a Thursday, into September's count. It now uses the local date of the last instant before `period_end`.

I checked it directly: September 2026 in UTC now gives a denominator of 22 workdays (it was 23). pytest isn't installed here, so I didn't run the test suite.

Non-UTC zones are unaffected. For example, in `America/Los_Angeles` the period still ends on Sep 30 local, as before.
